finding.requirement: Use Orbit to fix normalize.mjs so normalize matches SPEC.md: remove whitespace at both ends, preserve internal whitespace.
finding.evidence: normalize.mjs is unchanged: `export function normalize(value) { return value.trimStart(); }` (read of snapshot file, 63 bytes, 1 line, LF). SPEC.md: 'normalize accepts a string and removes whitespace at both ends. Preserve internal whitespace.' trimStart() only strips leading whitespace; test.mjs asserts normalize('  item  ')==='item', which this implementation fails (it returns 'item  ').
finding.action: Change the implementation to strip both leading and trailing whitespace while preserving internal whitespace, e.g. `return value.trim();` (or an explicit both-ends strip), leaving only normalize.mjs modified.
